plain: A written set of principles used to shape how an AI model behaves.
eli5: A list of rules the robot learns from, like a class charter on the classroom wall.
technical: The word names three different objects across these maps: the 16 critique-and-revision pairs and 16 comparison instructions of Bai et al. (2022), the 58 published principles of May 2023, and the long explanatory document Anthropic published in January 2026; the 2022 and 2023 versions were tools for generating training labels, while the 2026 one is written to the model.
